title: Reflexive 12: Mixed Review (What Job Is -ся Doing?)
description: The finisher for the whole track. The ending -ся / -сь does five different jobs. Today you name the job in any sentence and produce the right form. Nothing new is taught.
descriptionRussian: Завершающий урок всего раздела. Окончание -ся / -сь выполняет пять разных функций. Сегодня вы определяете функцию в любом предложении и образуете нужную форму. Ничего нового не вводится.
intro: One ending, five different jobs, and the only real skill is telling which one is at work. Sometimes the action comes back to the subject, sometimes it runs between people, sometimes the verb never existed without the ending in the first place, and sometimes nobody is doing it at all. Ask what job the ending is doing before you translate anything.
rules: Jobs 1 and 2, action on yourself: the action goes back to the subject and there is no other object (Маша моется, Антон бреется). Job 2 is the same idea focused on readiness: одеваться, собираться, готовиться (готовиться к + dative).
Job 3, action between people: the action is shared. The partner is added with с + the instrumental case. Маша встречается с Антоном.
Job 4, feeling and liking verbs that only exist with -ся: each needs its own case. Бояться + genitive, нравиться + dative, заниматься / гордиться + instrumental.
Job 5, the thing has something done to it: the subject undergoes the action and no doer is named. Дом строится, магазин закрывается.
examples: Маша моется холодной водой. (Masha washes herself with cold water.) Job 1: action on yourself.
Антон готовится к экзамену всю неделю. (Anton has been getting ready for the exam all week.) Job 2: getting ready, готовиться к + dative.
Маша встречается с Антоном уже два года. (Masha has been dating Anton for two years.) Job 3: action between people, с + instrumental partner.
Антон боится собак с детства. (Anton has been afraid of dogs since childhood.) Job 4: бояться + genitive.
Маше нравится новая школа. (Masha likes the new school.) Job 4: нравиться + dative; the liker Маша is in the dative, школа is the subject.
Магазин закрывается в десять часов. (The store closes at ten.) Job 5: the action happens to the store, no doer named.

patternRecognition.sentence: Маша моется холодной водой каждое утро.
patternRecognition.question: Which job is -ся doing here?
patternRecognition.explanation: Masha does the washing to herself, and there is no other object. This is Job 1: the action goes back to the subject.

patternRecognition.sentence: Антон собирается на работу и одевается.
patternRecognition.question: Which job is -ся doing here?
patternRecognition.explanation: Собираться (get ready to go) and одеваться (get dressed) are about getting yourself ready. This is Job 2, a kind of action on yourself focused on readiness.

patternRecognition.sentence: Маша и Антон встречаются по выходным.
patternRecognition.question: Which job is -ся doing here?
patternRecognition.explanation: The meeting is shared between Маша and Антон: each meets the other. This is Job 3, the action between people.

patternRecognition.sentence: Антон боится собак с самого детства.
patternRecognition.question: Which job is -ся doing here?
patternRecognition.explanation: Бояться has no plain twin and never drops the -ся. It needs the genitive: собак (gen plural of собака). This is Job 4.

patternRecognition.question: Which job is -ся doing here?
patternRecognition.explanation: Нравиться only exists with -ся. The liker is in the dative (Маше) and the liked thing (учитель) is the subject. This is Job 4.

patternRecognition.sentence: Новый дом строится рядом с парком.
patternRecognition.question: Which job is -ся doing here?
patternRecognition.explanation: The house does not act; the building happens to it, and no doer is named. This is Job 5.

patternRecognition.sentence: Магазин закрывается в десять часов вечера.
patternRecognition.question: Which job is -ся doing here?
patternRecognition.explanation: The store closes on its schedule; no one is named as closing it. This is Job 5, the action done to the thing.

items.promptEnglish: Every morning I wash my face with cold water.
items.hint: Job 1, action on yourself. The я-form ends in vowel -ю, so the ending is -сь.
items.explanation: Job 1: the washing goes back to you. The я-form умываю ends in vowel -ю, so add -сь: умываюсь.

items.prompt: Антон долго _____ перед выходом из дома.
items.promptEnglish: Anton spent a long time getting ready before leaving the house.
items.hint: Job 2, getting ready. The он-form ends in consonant -т, so the ending is -ся.
items.explanation: Job 2: собираться means 'get yourself ready to go.' The он-form собирает ends in consonant т, so add -ся: собирается.

items.prompt: Маша и Лена _____ каждый день в интернете.
items.promptEnglish: Masha and Lena write to each other every day online.
items.hint: Job 3, action between people, plural subject.
items.explanation: Job 3: переписываться is a shared action between two people. The plural subject Маша и Лена takes the они-form переписываются.

items.hint: Job 4: заниматься takes the instrumental for the activity.
items.explanation: Job 4: заниматься only exists with -ся and needs the instrumental for the activity. Спорт → спортом (-ом).

items.promptEnglish: Anton is afraid of the dark.
items.hint: Job 4: бояться takes the genitive for the source of fear.
items.explanation: Job 4: бояться takes the genitive. Темнота → темноты (-а → -ы). The source of fear is never an accusative object after бояться.

items.promptEnglish: The concert begins at exactly seven o'clock.
items.hint: Job 5: the event happens on its own, no doer is named.
items.explanation: Job 5: начинается is the form for 'the concert begins' with no doer named.

blanks: Маше _____ новая школа, поэтому она ходит туда с радостью. (Masha likes the new school, so she goes there happily.)
Эта статья легко _____ , потому что язык простой. (This article reads easily, because the language is simple.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: First blank is Job 4: нравиться only exists with -ся; the liker Маша is in the dative (Маше) and школа is the subject, so the verb is 3sg нравится. Second blank is Job 5: the article undergoes the reading and no reader is named, so the -ся form читается is correct.

errorCorrection.sentence: Маша моет каждое утро холодной водой.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Masha washes herself with cold water every morning.
errorCorrection.explanation: Job 1: the action goes back to Маша and there is no other object, so we need моется ('washes herself'). The plain мыть needs an object (мыть посуду 'wash the dishes'), so моет alone is incomplete.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон каждый день занимается футбол после школы.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton plays football every day after school.
errorCorrection.explanation: Заниматься needs the instrumental for the activity, so 'football' is футболом (футбол → футболом). The bare футбол looks like an English direct object, but заниматься takes no object.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон вчера помирился к своему брату после ссоры.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton made up with his brother yesterday after the quarrel.
errorCorrection.explanation: Job 3: the other person in a shared action is added with с + the instrumental case, so 'with his brother' is со своим братом (со before the cluster св-). The dative к своему брату means 'towards his brother' and does not mark a partner.

errorCorrection.sentence: Новый стадион строит сейчас на окраине города.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: A new stadium is being built now on the edge of the city.
errorCorrection.explanation: Job 5: the stadium undergoes the building and no doer is named, so we need строится. The plain строит ('is building something') needs an object, so it cannot stand with стадион as its subject.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha washes her car every Saturday.
minimalPairs.explanation: There is a direct object here: свою машину (her car). That calls for the plain мыть: моет. Моется ('washes herself') would clash with the object, because Job 1 has no other object.
Job 5: the door opens on its own and no doer is named, so открывается is correct. Открывает is the plain form ('someone opens the door') and would need a doer plus an object.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton has been afraid of the dark since childhood.
minimalPairs.explanation: Job 4: бояться only exists with -ся, so боится is the form; боит is not a Russian word. The source of fear takes the genitive: темноты.

sentenceBuilding.hint: Job 3: a shared action with one named partner uses с + the instrumental (с Антоном).

sentenceBuilding.translation: Anton is proud of his sister.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Job 4: гордиться takes the instrumental (сестрой), and своей agrees with it.

sentenceBuilding.answer: Дети купались в море всё лето.
sentenceBuilding.translation: The children were bathing in the sea all summer.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Job 1 in the past, plural: -ли ends in a vowel, so the ending is -сь (купались).
acceptableVariants: Дети купались в море всё лето
дети купались в море всё лето

sentenceBuilding.translation: The lesson begins at eight o'clock.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Job 5: the lesson begins on its own, no doer named (начинается).

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each sentence by the job the -ся verb is doing.

items.word: Маша и Антон целуются на прощание.

reviewVocab.definition: to wash oneself / to get dressed: action on yourself (Маша моется; Антон одевается)
reviewVocab.example: Маша моется холодной водой, а Антон быстро одевается.

reviewVocab.definition: to meet or date (someone): a shared action; the partner takes с + the instrumental (с Антоном)
reviewVocab.example: Маша встречается с Антоном уже два года.

reviewVocab.definition: to be afraid of: a feeling verb that only exists with -ся and takes the genitive (Антон боится собак)
reviewVocab.example: Антон боится собак с самого детства.

reviewVocab.definition: to be liked by: the liker is in the dative and the liked thing is the subject (Маше нравится кофе)
to do as an activity / to be proud of: feeling and activity verbs that only exist with -ся and take the instrumental (заниматься спортом, гордиться сестрой)
reviewVocab.example: Маша занимается спортом, а Антон гордится своей сестрой.
